title: List what you need
recap: Pipo made your checklist for this year's tax paperwork.
funFact: Agents can fill in forms for you, but your name goes on them. Next, Pipo fills in your expense form, and you decide when it's submitted.
postcard: a tidy desk with a neat stack of tax papers and a checklist: {answer}
situation: Tax time is coming up! Want me to list what you need to gather?
facts: 💼 A salary job, plus freelance design work
💻 You bought a laptop for work
💝 You gave to a local charity
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on someone's phone. Help with what they ask. Keep tax talk general, not tied to one country's rules.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: List the papers to gather for my taxes
pieces.text: List the documents and receipts I need to gather for this year's tax paperwork.

slots.label: What does Pipo need to know?

pieces.label: A salary job, plus freelance design
pieces.text: I have a salary job, and I also did freelance design work for clients.

pieces.label: I bought a laptop for work
pieces.text: I bought a laptop for work this year.

pieces.label: I gave to a local charity
pieces.text: I gave money to a local charity.

pieces.label: Just the usual stuff, you know
pieces.text: Just the usual stuff, you know.
pieces.tip: Pipo doesn't know what's usual for you. Your jobs and big work purchases are what change the list.

pieces.label: A short checklist
pieces.text: Give me a short checklist, one item per line.

pieces.label: Explain how taxes work
pieces.tip: A lesson on taxes is long. A checklist is something you can act on today.

flaws.hint: "Help me with my taxes" doesn't say you want a list of papers to gather.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you wanted a list of papers, so it gave general tax tips instead.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo about your freelance work.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you freelance, so your invoices aren't on the list.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo about the laptop you bought for work.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know about the laptop, so its receipt isn't on the list.

lesson: Pipo can only list what fits your life if you tell it what's in your life: your jobs and your big costs.
